label: Paddy
rule_sources: FAO Ecocrop pH; rainfed paddy only in high-rainfall (coastal/malnad) zones per UAS PoP; yield_factor converts DES rice to paddy (67% outturn)

label: Maize
rule_sources: FAO Ecocrop; TNAU Agritech (rabi maize irrigated)

label: Jowar (sorghum)
rule_sources: ICAR-IIMR: rabi sorghum on stored moisture of medium/deep black soils

label: Groundnut
rule_sources: ICAR-DGR: light/medium soils preferred; rabi groundnut irrigated

label: Sunflower
rule_sources: ICAR-IIOR: 3-4 year gap between sunflower crops

label: Bengal gram (chickpea)
rule_sources: ICAR-IIPR: chickpea on residual moisture; avoid continuous chickpea (wilt)

label: Wheat
rule_sources: ICAR-IIWBR: peninsular wheat irrigated; rainfed only on deep black soils

label: Safflower
rule_sources: ICAR-IIOR: rainfed rabi oilseed on deep black soils
